description:
PhonePe helps users in India handle daily payments, bookings, and basic financial tasks in one place. It suits common situations like splitting rent with roommates, paying utility bills on the due date, or checking out at a neighborhood store without cash. The interface brings together bank-linked UPI transfers, QR payments, recharges, and travel bookings in a straightforward flow. With reliable acceptance at local shops and online merchants, the app fits routine use throughout the month. Users seeking a direct install can find the PhonePe APK from trusted sources.


PhonePe features that matter

UPI payments and bank account control

PhonePe lets you send and receive money using BHIM UPI while keeping multiple bank accounts in one view. You can use UPI Lite for small-value payments without entering a UPI PIN each time. Support is available for RuPay credit card on UPI and Credit Line on UPI, so you can pay from linked credit or credit line accounts where enabled. PhonePe keeps transfers quick and organizes balances for day-to-day use.

Pay at stores, online, and across regions

You can scan any compatible QR to pay at local shops, pharmacies, and service counters. PhonePe also works on many apps and websites, so checkout is consistent across services you use often. For travel abroad, PhonePe supports international UPI at select locations in Singapore, UAE, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, and Mauritius where acceptance is available. This coverage helps you keep using UPI beyond your home city when the merchant supports it.

Bills, recharges, and regular dues

PhonePe helps you take care of mobile and DTH recharges, electricity and water bills, gas, broadband and landline bills, and rent. You can also pay credit card dues and loan repayments within the app. Setting reminders and paying on time keeps monthly tasks in one place, which reduces switching between services. The app records past payments so you can track bill history when needed.

Travel and commute bookings

With PhonePe, you can book flights, trains, and buses, and also reserve hotels in advance. For city travel, you can manage metro and cab payments inside the app. FASTag top-ups are supported so toll payments on highways remain uninterrupted. These options bring trip planning and daily commute payments into the same wallet view.

Investments and insurance options

PhonePe includes simple investment choices like mutual funds across liquid, tax-saving, equity, debt, and hybrid categories. You can buy or sell 24K gold and set up Gold SIPs, or contribute to NPS and Recurring Deposits. Insurance discovery and purchase are available for Health, Term Life, Car or Bike, Personal Accident, Travel, and Shop coverage. These options let you handle long-term planning in the same app you use for PhonePe UPI payments.


PhonePe app notes before you install

PhonePe is widely accepted across Indian postal codes and among a broad base of merchants. This means users commonly find compatible QR codes and online checkouts in most cities and many towns. Account login uses your mobile number and one time password during setup, followed by your UPI PIN for authorizing payments. For linking a bank account, the mobile number on the phone should match the one registered with that bank.


PhonePe Business and the consumer app

There is a separate PhonePe Business app designed for merchants to accept payments and manage settlements. The consumer PhonePe app focuses on personal payments, bills, travel bookings, investments, and insurance. If you run a shop and want to collect payments, search specifically for PhonePe Business. If you are paying friends, bills, or stores as a customer, use the consumer app.


How to use PhonePe on Android

This quick guide outlines the basics to get started after you download PhonePe. It focuses on first use, linking your bank account, and making an initial payment. The steps help you move from install to everyday use with clarity.

  1. Open PhonePe and enter your mobile number. Verify the number with the one time password sent by SMS to complete sign in.
  2. Next, add your bank account by choosing your bank from the list. Ensure the same mobile number is registered with the bank so the app can fetch your account.
  3. Set or confirm your UPI PIN for that bank account. This PIN will be required to authorize most payments within the app.
  4. To pay, tap Scan to pay at a store QR, or choose To Contact, To Bank, or To UPI ID for a person or business. Check the recipient details and enter the amount.
  5. Review the summary and confirm with your UPI PIN. After payment, view the receipt and find it later in your transaction history when needed.


Get started with PhonePe

PhonePe brings payments, bills, bookings, and basic money management into one Android app. Users who prefer the newest capabilities can look for the PhonePe latest version when installing. Choose the consumer app for personal use or the PhonePe Business app if you need to accept payments as a merchant.

For official details or product help, visit the developer’s website below.

  • Official website: https://www.phonepe.com/

How does Peaks work?

Our app makes investing in sustainable index funds easy and accessible to everyone. Also known as ETFs, these baskets contain hundreds of different stocks and bonds. Connect your bank account with the Peaks app to automatically start investing. You can invest with both large and small amounts, you can even invest your spare change. Decide on your risk profile and which deposit options are suitable for you.

Investing made easy:

• Invest in a globally diversified portfolio of ETFs.

• Low (fixed and variable) fees. No transaction costs.

• Automatically invest on a daily, Weekly or monthly basis.

How is my money invested?

With Peaks you choose one of four portfolios: Cautious, Balanced, Ambitious or Adventurous. Every portfolio has a different distribution between stocks and bonds. Stocks (ownership in a company) fluctuate in value. Bonds (loads to governments and companies) are more stable. With bonds you take less risk, however they can also provide lower returns in comparison to stocks.

You are also able to customize your own portfolio. This way you can make a selection from 16 different thematic and regional index funds. As an example, you can choose to only invest in Dutch companies or invest in companies that focus on automation & robotics or sustainable energy.

All funds offered by Peaks are carefully selected and provided by internationally recognised index fund providers such as iShares, UBS and DWS. This is important to ensure high quality.

Deposit funds the way you prefer

We offer different ways to deposit your money. Invest your spare change or deposit on a monthly basis. You can also invest your windfalls, set aside a fixed weekly amount or perform one time deposits whenever it suits you. You can withdraw your funds at any time.

How much does Peaks cost?

Investing is never free. However, we try to keep our costs as low and understandable as possible. You can calculate the costs corresponding to your situation on our website.

Summary of the costs:

• Peaks app during your first month: no cost

• Deposit and withdraw funds: no cost

• Change your portfolio: no cost

• Peaks app: The Start package is €1,99 per month. For the more extensive packages Complete and Premium you pay €2,99 or €4,99 per month. Moreover, you pay a variable fee between 0,25% to 0.5% of the total value of your investments per year.

• Fund cost: 0,15 to 0,23% per year of the total value of your investments. These fees are deducted from your returns by the fund operator automatically. They are not handled separately.

• Spread: with every deposit, withdrawal or portfolio change a small fee (between 0,03%-0,05%) occurs by the marketmakers of the index funds.

Good to know

We do not want you to take unnecessary risk. That’s why it is important to only invest money you can afford. After all, the value of your investments always fluctuates. Picture this: you need money right away, but the value of your investments is going down. Then you risk losing a chunk of your deposit(s) because you are selling your investments at a loss. An investment account should be an addition to your usual savings.

Would you like to know more?

Visit www.peaks.com

Investing always involves risks. Be aware that you could lose (part of) your money invested.

Whats Left is a free-libre App for "anti-budgeting" (figuring out what's left in your account based on uncleared transactions).

License: GPL v3 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html)

Coffee cup artwork license: Attribution CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/)

You can get the source code here: https://github.com/josephvanpelt/WhatsLeft/tree/master

Budgeting

I recommend that you create a budget, but this app can be helpful for times when you need to decide if you have enough money for an important investment (or maybe you didn't stick to the budget that well).

Privacy

The app requires no extra permissions. Nothing is sent out or shared (by design). All the data entered in the app is only stored on the phone in a sqlite database. The database is stored in the sandbox that android provides (encryption planned for future versions).

How it works

1. On the first page you enter what is currently showing as your account balance.

• The pattern behind it — you see what was spotted, not just an arrow

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

A signal here is not a message that scrolls away. Each one moves through waiting, in play, and then won, lost or expired, with targets ticking off as price reaches them. The history stays readable, including the losses. A signal you cannot check afterwards is only an opinion.

Wise features for global money

International transfers to 140+ countries

You can send money across borders with upfront fees and no hidden markups. Choose convenient funding options like bank transfer, debit or credit cards, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. Each transfer includes real time tracking on your phone, so you follow progress from creation to delivery. As a result, regular payments feel straightforward and timely.

Real exchange rates and useful alerts

Wise applies the mid market rate, which is the rate you see on independent sources. You can set rate alerts to act when the rate reaches a level you prefer. For repeat payments, Wise lets you reuse past transfers to save time and reduce mistakes. This keeps routine transactions simple and consistent.

Receive like a local in multiple regions

You get local account details to receive money in places like the UK, the EU with IBAN, Australia, and more. Incoming payments and direct debits are free, which helps with salary, invoices, or reimbursements. Push notifications confirm when money arrives, so you do not need to check manually. As a result, receiving funds abroad feels similar to using a domestic account.

Multi currency account and Wise debit card

Wise lets you hold over 40 currencies and convert instantly with low fees. The Wise debit card works for spending and withdrawals worldwide, while auto conversion selects the best available rate at payment time. You can freeze or unfreeze the card in the app to control usage while traveling. This setup supports daily spending for expats and frequent travelers.

Security and business readiness

Your money is safeguarded with leading banks, and security measures include two factor authentication, encryption, and biometrics. Wise is authorised by regulators such as the FCA, and operates through an RBI approved partner model in India. For business users, Wise supports paying invoices at better rates, receiving like a local, and connecting with platforms such as Amazon, Stripe, and Xero. This helps small teams manage international operations from one place.


Important notes about Wise pricing and availability

Wise keeps pricing transparent by showing the mid market rate and clear fees before you confirm. For details by route and payment method, check the official site for current pricing information. Availability and onboarding steps can vary by country due to local regulations, including India and Nigeria, so supported features may differ. Wise was previously known as TransferWise, and the current name appears across the app and services.


How to send money with Wise

This short guide explains how to make an international transfer on Android. To begin, install the Wise APK and sign in to your account.

  1. Open Wise, tap Send, and choose the country you want to send to.
  2. Enter the recipient’s details and select the delivery method required in that country.
  3. Type the amount, then review the upfront fee and the mid market exchange rate.
  4. Select a funding option such as bank transfer, card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay, and use camera capture for card details if needed.
  5. Confirm the transfer, enable notifications, and track each step in real time until the money arrives.


Get started with Wise on Android

Wise is a practical way to send and receive money internationally, hold multiple currencies, and spend with a debit card. For dependable cross border payments on mobile, use the Wise latest version and manage transfers with clear fees.

description:
Jar is made for users in India who want to build a savings habit without setting aside a large amount at once. It lets you put small amounts into digital gold and view your balance from your phone. As a result, the app can suit people who prefer short, regular saving actions instead of one large investment. If you plan to download Jar, it is useful to understand how gold prices, withdrawals, and charges work before you start.


Jar Features

Small digital gold savings

Jar lets you start saving in 24K digital gold with small amounts. You can begin with ₹10 for daily savings, ₹50 for weekly savings, or ₹100 for monthly savings. This makes the Jar app suitable for users who want to test gold savings with a low starting amount before choosing a larger plan.

Automatic saving plans

Jar supports daily, weekly, and monthly saving plans, so you can set a schedule that matches your income and spending pattern. After choosing an amount and frequency, the app helps you keep adding to your gold balance over time. This approach is similar to a Gold SIP, where small regular payments build a gold holding gradually.

Live gold price details

Jar shows live gold prices with real time gold rate updates and purity information. Before buying digital gold, you can check the current rate inside the app and decide whether to continue. Since gold prices can change during the day, this information helps you understand the amount of gold your payment will buy.

Withdrawal and physical gold options

Jar allows you to withdraw savings instantly to a bank account when you need money. You can also convert digital gold into physical gold, depending on the options available in the app. This gives users a choice between keeping gold digitally and using the value for cash needs.

Extra financial and shopping services

Along with Jar gold savings, the app includes other services such as UPI payments, personal loans for selected users, insurance, and gold or silver jewellery shopping. These services are separate from basic digital gold saving. Therefore, users should review each service inside the app before using it, especially when it involves payments, borrowing, or insurance.


What to Know Before Using Jar

Jar focuses on micro savings, so it may make sense for users who want to save small amounts often instead of buying gold in a larger amount. However, digital gold is still linked to market prices. The value of your gold can move up or down based on the current gold rate.

When buying digital gold, users should also check charges shown in the app. Gold purchases may include GST, and the buying price can be different from the selling price because of the spread between purchase and sale rates. For this reason, it is better to review the final amount, gold quantity, and any listed charge before confirming a transaction in the Jar APK.


Jar Safety and Gold Storage

Jar states that gold purchases are backed by physical gold stored in secure vaults and insured for safety. This matters because digital gold represents a claim on physical gold rather than a coin or bar held by the user. The app also uses UPI based payments for transactions, so users should confirm payment details carefully before approving any transfer.

For users comparing a digital gold app with other saving methods, storage and withdrawal rules are important. Jar offers insured vault storage and an instant withdrawal option, but users should still read the in app details for limits, processing steps, and conversion rules. This helps avoid confusion when selling gold or moving savings to a bank account.


How to Use Jar on Android

After installing the Jar latest version on an Android phone, you can use the app to start a small digital gold saving routine. The process mainly involves setting up your account, choosing how much to save, and checking the gold value before each action.

  1. Open Jar and sign in with the required mobile number or account details.
  2. Review the digital gold section, then check the live gold rate and purity information shown in the app.
  3. Choose whether to save instantly or set a daily, weekly, or monthly saving plan.
  4. Enter the amount you want to save, starting from the small amount options supported by Jar.
  5. Confirm the payment details, complete the transaction, and then track your gold balance in the app.

If you later need to use your savings, open the withdrawal or sell option inside Jar and review the current selling value. You can then choose bank withdrawal if available, or check physical gold conversion options. Since rates and charges can affect the final amount, confirm all details before completing the request.


Start Saving with Jar

Jar is a digital gold app for users who want to build a small and regular saving habit through 24K digital gold. It supports automatic saving plans, live gold rate checks, instant withdrawal, and physical gold conversion. You can use Jar download options on APKPure to get the app and review its saving tools on your Android phone.

description:
After the unified invoice lottery draw, you can check your prizes with a single tap in the Invoice Savings Book. All invoices for the entire period can be checked at once, including general prizes and exclusive prizes from cloud invoices. After setting up your prize-claiming account, winnings from cloud invoices will be automatically deposited into your bank account. Once mobile barcodes, credit cards, EasyCards, and other electronic devices are registered, invoices from those devices will be automatically transferred and accumulated into monthly expenses based on spending categories. Saving invoices is essentially bookkeeping. Enabling price increase alerts will notify you of any increases in subscription or monthly fees.

The Invoice Savings Book is a unified invoice prize checking and e-invoice management app: it includes prize checking, scanning, winning number lookup, mobile barcode device registration, invoice bookkeeping and spending analysis, regular expense and price increase alerts, and membership card storage. Saving invoices also allows you to participate in invoice reward activities and earn coins by completing tasks.

◤ Uniform Invoice Check: Check your winnings with one click after the draw, and know immediately!

● Cloud Invoice Check: After the draw, tap the check card in "My Invoices" to check all invoices for the current period, including those imported by vehicle, scanned, and manually entered, all at once. General prizes and cloud invoice-specific prizes are displayed separately as checked/unchecked. Winning a cloud invoice-specific prize (NT$1 million, NT$2,000, NT$800, NT$500) will also be indicated. If a cloud invoice-specific prize hasn't been drawn yet, the app will prompt you to check later; you can also "Check the Latest Cloud Invoice-Specific Prizes" in the upper right menu.

● Check Results: The results of each period's invoice check can be created as a shareable image, showing the number of winning invoices and the prize amount. You can share it with friends, whether you won or not.

● Scan to Check Prizes: Point the camera at the QR code on the left side of the e-invoice. The camera continuously scans invoices one after another. For periods with already drawn prizes, scanning automatically checks the prize and immediately displays the result. New invoices are simultaneously saved to the invoice passbook, and transaction details are retrieved. Repeated scans of the same invoice will not save it twice. Invoices from future dates will be blocked.

● Scan Assistance: Flash and sound effects can be turned on/off. Different sound effects are provided for winning, not winning, and no period, along with vibration feedback.

● Traditional Invoices: Switch to "Traditional Invoices" and use text recognition to read the invoice number for prize checking. If the period cannot be determined, you will be prompted to select a period. After checking, you can press "Save Invoice" to go to the manual addition page to save.

● Last Three Digits Check: Enter the last three digits of the invoice using the numeric keypad. The system instantly displays which prize has been won and reads the numbers aloud. You can check a single period or two or more winning periods simultaneously.

● Uniform Invoice Winning Numbers: The draw is held on the 25th of odd-numbered months. The "Winning Numbers" page lists the special prize, grand prize, first prize numbers, and the rules for second to sixth prizes, and displays the prize claim period. Winning numbers can be manually updated.

● Draw Countdown and Reminders: "My Invoices" displays the countdown to the draw in N days. After the draw, entering "My Invoices" will trigger a pop-up message: "Invoice Draw is here! Check your prize now!" Click to check the entire draw period.

● Data Source: Winning numbers and cloud invoice data are from the Ministry of Finance's Electronic Invoice Integration Service Platform, subject to the Ministry of Finance's announcements. The invoice passbook is developed by a private company and does not represent the Ministry of Finance or any government agency.

◤ Prize Redemption: Prizes are automatically deposited into your account, no need to go to convenience stores ◢

● After setting up your prize claim account, the prize money from the winning cloud invoices on your mobile phone and in your account will be automatically deposited into your bank account. You no longer need to go to convenience store kiosks to print and queue for prize redemption.

● Prize Claim Account: Access "Prize Claim Account" from the vehicle page or settings, and complete the Ministry of Finance remittance account setup within the app. Prizes from winning cloud invoices will then be deposited into this account.

● The details page of the winning invoice will display the prize amount and include instructions for claiming the prize on either the vehicle or paper invoice.

◤ Mobile Barcode Vehicle: One barcode manages all invoices ◢

● Mobile Barcode: Log in using your mobile phone number and vehicle verification code (Ministry of Finance password). If you don't have a mobile barcode, you can apply for one through the Ministry of Finance page within the app. Forgot your verification code or need to update it can also be handled within the app. After registration, the barcode will be displayed on the vehicle page.

● Show Barcode: The mobile barcode on the vehicle page can be kept constantly lit, automatically adjusting the screen brightness. The barcode can be copied with one click. A barcode panel can also be quickly expanded on the homepage without switching pages.

● Card Account Registration: Credit cards/debit cards, EasyCards, iCash 2.0, online shopping memberships, cross-border e-commerce email accounts, and other card types can all be registered and bound to the Ministry of Finance's website within the app. After registration, invoices from the card will be automatically transferred, eliminating the need for paper invoices.

● Utility Bill Registration: Simply scan the two- or three-segment barcode on the bill within the app to register it.

● Registered Card List: Lists each registered card, account number, and the number of invoices for each card, sorted by number. Clicking on a card will display its invoices.

● New Invoice Notification: When a new card invoice arrives while the app is running, a notification will pop up at the top of the screen: "New invoices arrived in months X-Y!"

● Verification Code Expiration Reminder: If the Ministry of Finance changes the verification code, causing synchronization issues, the app will remind and guide you to update the verification code.

● Invoice Push Notifications: After logging in, you can find the "Invoice Push Notifications" switch in "Settings > Privacy & Notifications". You'll be notified when invoices are saved. You can turn it on or off freely. If system notifications are not enabled, the app will guide you to enable them in system settings.

● Charity Code and Donated Invoices: The vehicle page can be switched to a charity code barcode, which can be presented directly at checkout. Simply search and set a donation unit first. Donable invoices can also be donated on the details page. Search by unit name or charity code, and the previous donation units will be listed. Details and analysis will be retained after donation.

◤ Save Invoices and Get Rewards ◢

● Invoice Rewards: Reward activity cards will appear in your "My Invoices" list, showing activity details and rewards such as coins. You can participate and claim rewards directly from the card upon completion. Activities and rewards vary by tier, and some activities also include a lucky draw.

● Tasks and Coins: View the progress, deadline, and coin rewards for each task on the "Collect Points for Rewards" task page. Claim coins upon completion.

● Shop: Redeem convenience store vouchers, Japanese vouchers, experience/coupons from various platforms, or app themes with coins. Some items can be claimed directly; each item shows the remaining quantity and redemption period.

● My Items: Redeemed vouchers are stored centrally. Redemption codes and discount codes can be copied with one click, barcodes are always displayed, and redemption status is also indicated; physical prizes can have recipient information filled in.

● Redemption Code: Enter the redemption code in "My Items" to receive vouchers or coins.

● Friend Invitation Code: Everyone has a unique invitation code. New friends enter it once after joining, and both parties receive coins upon successful verification.

◤ Invoice Details and Accounting ◢

● Invoice Details: For each invoice, you can view the purchased items, store, seller's code, vehicle type, and winning status. Item details cannot be found for invoices without a random code, invoices with a buyer's code, traditional long invoices, and invoices for some vehicles; the app will indicate the reason.

● Notes: Each invoice can be edited and notes can be added (maximum 50 characters). Invoices without a store name will have the notes titled.

● Spending Categorization: Invoices are categorized into 6 types: Dining, Home, Transportation, Shopping, Entertainment, and Other. Monthly expenses are accumulated, and saving invoices is equivalent to bookkeeping.

● Search and Filter: Search all invoices by item or store name. Results can be sorted by date or price, and search history is saved and can be cleared at any time. Invoice lists can be filtered by source (vehicle, scanned, manually entered) or the 6 spending categories.

● Manual Addition: For electronic or traditional invoices with damaged barcodes, you can enter the consumption date, invoice number (2 alphanumeric characters plus 8 digits), amount, and random code (optional; details can only be viewed if this is entered), plus a note. Click "Save and Enter Next" to continuously enter invoices; duplicate invoice numbers will be blocked.

● Recover invoices even when switching phones: After logging in, all invoices from vehicles, scanned invoices, and manually entered invoices will be synced to your account. If you switch phones and log in again, the invoices from the most recent 7 periods will be synced back. Editing or deleting invoices will also sync them.

● Invoice Export: Export CSV files for free via the "My Invoices" menu in the upper right corner or the "Invoice Export" option in settings. These files can be opened directly with Excel. You can choose any month from the current month or the previous 12 months to export one month at a time. Choose one of two formats: "All Invoices" includes the consumption time, invoice number, store, seller's code, item, unit price, quantity, subtotal, total, and remarks; or "Consumption Details Only" includes the consumption date, item, unit price, quantity, subtotal, and store name. Share or send the exported invoice.

● Delete Invoices: You can delete a single invoice or all scanned and manually entered invoices from the current period. Vehicle invoices will be retained.

◤ Spending Analysis and Budgeting ◢

● Homepage Spending Summary: Displays the cumulative spending and number of transactions for the month, whether it's more or less than last month, and detailed amounts for each category; clicking on a category allows you to view its monthly details and switch months.

● Budget Management: Set your monthly total budget on the homepage; with sufficient data, you can apply a suggested budget calculated based on recent spending with one click. The homepage displays the cumulative spending, remaining balance, and total amount for the month, with alerts based on four statuses: just started, well-controlled, nearing the limit, and overspending.

● Category Analysis: Pie charts present the amount and percentage of spending in six categories: dining, home, transportation, shopping, entertainment, and others.

● Prize Analysis: Displays the cumulative invoice winning probability for a given period, the number of invoices for each category, and the percentage of users who have won the "Invoice Master Index."

● Vehicle Analysis: Displays the number of vehicles registered, the number of invoices issued for each vehicle this month, and the "Paper Saving and Earth Saving Index."

● Store Analysis: Displays the spending amount and frequency for each store, along with charts showing the time of day for each transaction.

● Time Analysis: Total number of transactions for the month, peak transaction times, and transaction frequency and amount for each time period.

● Invoice-Based Counties: Calculates scores for the entire island and specific counties/cities based on your invoices. You can switch regions to view the results; some regions are not yet available.

● Each analysis page has a share button for image sharing.

◤ Recurring Expenses: Subscription and Monthly Fee Increase Alerts ◢

● Recurring Expenses: Organizes fixed deductions from vehicle invoices, including cloud storage, AI tools, video streaming, gym memberships, parking fees, and utilities, listing the monthly amount and total for each item.

● Price Increase Alerts: Notifies you when a recurring expense significantly increases compared to previous periods, allowing you to decide whether to renew; utilities are compared to the same period last year.

● Pre-Bill Reminders: Reminds you before the next billing cycle after activation, allowing you to confirm whether you have cancelled your subscription or completed payment.

◤ Membership Card Storage ◢

● Add Membership Cards: Choose brands from the store's card list or add custom cards; card numbers can be scanned with a camera or entered manually, supporting common 1D barcodes and QR codes; custom cards can be photographed or have their designs selected from the album.

● Show Membership Cards: The card page displays both the membership card barcode and the mobile barcode, which are shown together at checkout. Both can be enlarged by clicking.

● Manage Membership Cards: Record member names, phone numbers, and notes; modify card names; drag and drop to sort card order; delete unused cards; generate shareable screens containing card designs, barcodes, and QR codes to send to family members.

◤ Widgets and Personalization Settings ◢

● 5 Desktop Widgets: Basic barcode, custom barcode, horizontal membership card, vertical membership card, membership card & carrier; carriers can be displayed without opening the app; widget colors switch between light and dark modes.

● Customizable Widgets: Use your own photo as a background (supports transparent images, under 10MB), zoom and drag to crop with two fingers, barcode text can be selected in black or white; tap the widget to copy the barcode.

● Wear OS Smartwatch: Show your phone's barcode on the watch for a larger display with automatic brightness adjustment; tap a membership card to show its barcode or QR code; phone barcodes can also be added to the watch's information tile, swiped to display.

● Biometric Lock: After enabling, launching the app requires fingerprint or facial recognition, or you can use a device password to unlock.

● App Themes: Multiple themes can be redeemed with coins in the store and applied in "My Items"; Dark mode can be selected to follow the system settings, or turned on or off.
